proposals.title: Shareholder proposal to amend the proxy access bylaw to remove the shareholder group limit
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to enable as many shareholders as needed to combine shares to equal 3% (held 3 years) to use proxy access, removing the 20-shareholder group limit.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that shareholders vote Against the shareholder proposal to amend the proxy access bylaw to remove the shareholder group limit.
